_comment: Snapshot of popular actions, refreshed from GitHub tag listings on snapshot_date. latest_major = newest major release at that time; min_supported_major = oldest major that still runs on a supported runtime and has not been shut down. Use --check-latest to query GitHub for live release data instead.

actions/checkout.note: v1-v3 run on Node 12/16, both retired by GitHub.

actions/upload-artifact.note: v1-v3 were shut down on 30 Jan 2025 and fail at runtime.

actions/download-artifact.note: v1-v3 were shut down on 30 Jan 2025 and fail at runtime.

actions/cache.note: v1, v2 and early v3 releases stopped working in early 2025 when the legacy cache service was retired.

actions/create-release.deprecated: Archived and unmaintained since 2021; use softprops/action-gh-release or the gh CLI.

actions/upload-release-asset.deprecated: Archived and unmaintained since 2021; use softprops/action-gh-release or the gh CLI.

vulnerable.summary: Compromised in March 2025: every version tag was rewritten to point at a malicious commit that dumped the runner's memory (including secrets) into the job log.
vulnerable.fix: Upgrade to v46.0.1 or later, pin to a full commit SHA, and rotate any secrets that were available to affected runs.

vulnerable.summary: The v1 tag was compromised in March 2025 to leak CI secrets to the job log (the initial foothold of the tj-actions incident).
vulnerable.fix: Pin to a full commit SHA of v1.3.2 or later and rotate exposed secrets.

vulnerable.summary: Path traversal while extracting artifacts allows a crafted artifact to write files outside the destination directory.
